experiment: 016-loso (E7, Amendment 16 of docs/04-phase4-plan.md; exploratory under D-016)

fov224.note: resize-based launderings (jpeg75_resize05, social_sim, screenshot_sim, mavali_medium) leave < 224 px on a 224 crop and cannot go through the 224 center-crop backbone (features.Backbone.to_tensor raises); only JPEG-only conditions are feasible

feature_layout: 004 secondary = [blk4 CLS|blk4 mean|blk8 CLS|blk8 mean|blk12 CLS|blk12 mean], H=768; block 12 == B0 primary

d3_split.by: id (real + its 4 fakes together), permutation of sorted ids

label_rule: PASS: every held-out source AUROC >= 0.85 and FPR <= 5% AND mean(F_b8 - F_last) >= 0.03 with CI lo > 0 AND mean AUROC(2 train sources) - mean AUROC(1 train source) > 0 with CI lo > 0. KILL: any held-out source AUROC < 0.75 or FPR > 10%. Else INCONCLUSIVE. All at jpeg75_resize05, F_b8, T-aug, fov512.

fpr_threshold_readings.A: threshold = 1% FPR on the training sources' calib reals' CLEAN scores (E6/D-009 convention), applied at jpeg75_resize05 (headline)
fpr_threshold_readings.B: threshold = 1% FPR on the training sources' calib reals scored under the SAME condition (laundered calibration; sensitivity)

calib: calib-role reals of the training sources; VISION calib = natives + WA + FBH (E6 convention)
bootstrap: 1,000 replicates, one global plan per arm: test-role clusters drawn with replacement within kind: families (caption id for RAISE reals and all fakes; id for D3), devices (VISION), images (OI); weights shared by all methods and sources (paired differences)
train: lib/probe.fit_probe, balanced, StratifiedGroupKFold groups: device (VISION) / family id / image; T-aug copies share their source's group. Natives only as VISION train reals (E6). No subsampling of sources.
